name: TTS Vocal
description: Generate an AI text-to-speech vocal sample from text using a saved profile. Runs on the desktop host, not in Live.

fields.label: Profile
fields.hint: Saved profiles from Settings → TTS Vocal Profiles.

fields.label: Voice override
fields.hint: Leave blank to use the profile's saved voice ID.

fields.label: Speed override
fields.hint: e.g. 1.0 = normal. Leave blank to use the profile's default.

fields.label: Language / pronunciation
fields.hint: e.g. en, es. Affects how words are pronounced. xAI also accepts 'auto'.

fields.label: Destination
fields.hint: Save to PC asks where to put the file. Add to Live Set places it on the first ticked audio track.
